description: Installation of various illuminated and non-illuminated external car dealership and forecourt signs
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The display of the advertisement hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission
Condition : 3 - Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisments, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site
Condition : 4 - Any structure or hoarding erected and used principally for the purpose of displaying advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public
Condition : 5 - Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity
Condition : 6 - The illuminated advertisement signs hereby consented shall not exceed a luminance of 300cd/m2 between sunset and sunrise

Condition : 7 - Signs shall be fitted with a light intensity monitoring censor to ensure the illuminance intensity is dimmable to take account of ambient light conditions and comply with the maximum recommended lighting intensity

Condition : 8 - The luminance levels will be checked once every 6 months and adjusted if necessary to ensure that the lighting intensity between sunset and sunrise remains within the permitted levels as prescribed in (1) above
Condition : 9 - The sign must not have any moving features, animation, intermittent light source or exposed cold cathode tubing, must not flash or change colour.

Condition : 10 - The erection of the signage shall not take place until a method statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local authority in consultation with Highways England, and these works shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 11 - The footway and carriageway on Great South West Road must not be blocked during the construction and maintenance of the proposal. Temporary obstruction during the installation must be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrian, or obstruct the flow of traffic. In addition, no servicing vehicles associated with the proposed signs shall park/ load/ unload on the footway/ carriageway of Great South West Road at any time.
